name: Sokodé

queries.query: Sokode Togo cadastral parcel map official land registry
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official OTR/DCCFE cadastre and land-conservation service, including a Regional Division in Sokodé. The national Geodata portal was also found, but no public parcel layer was exposed in its anonymous configuration or WMS capabilities.

queries.query: Sokodé Togo cadastre parcellaire carte officielle registre foncier
queries.result: La recherche officielle a confirmé la DCCFE de l'OTR comme administration cadastrale et foncière, avec une Division Régionale à Sokodé. Le communiqué officiel de 2024 crée le Numéro Unique Parcellaire (NUP), mais aucun service public anonyme ne fournit un identifiant parcellaire sûr avec géométrie.

registryCustodian.name: Office Togolais des Recettes (OTR), Direction du Cadastre, de la Conservation Foncière et de l'Enregistrement (DCCFE), Division Régionale Sokodé
registryCustodian.scope: Local/regional cadastral and land-conservation custodian evidenced by the official DCCFE contacts page; national OTR/DCCFE services and NUP policy are recorded separately from public geometry access.

Official contacts page lists Division Régionale Sokodé, establishing local custodial presence; no geometry or parcel records returned.
Official 2024 NUP notice states a national unique parcel identifier is created from 1 August 2024; it does not publish a parcel schema, geometry service, or safe sample.
